items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I think the oldest guy in the band was a guy named Johnny Polonski and I think he was 19, and I think he was the oldest guy in the band.

ctx.x: About my age, yeah. I think the oldest guy in the band was a guy named Johnny Polonski and I think he was 19, and I think he was the oldest guy in the band. I mean he got kids you know, because we didn’t make very much money. And John Polonski ended up having a terrific career, his name became John Parker, and he did a lot of film work. He did music for a lot of television series and motion pictures. He did very well. But that was the beginning of it and that sort of got me hooked. A sort of humorous story, I was…
Yeah. You remembered what your father said. Something’s going to happen, and he was right.
